<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LegoSets" name="Lego brick sets"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SortedContainers" name="Sorted containers"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LegoMachine">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Builder" name="Machine builder" processRef="Process_Builder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Children" name="Group of children" processRef="Process_Children"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SetsToChildren" name="Give Lego sets"
                      sourceRef="Task_GiveSets" targetRef="Start_ReceiveSets"
                      messageRef="Message_LegoSets"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SortedToBuilder" name="Return sorted containers"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReturnSorted" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"
                      messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Builder" name="Build a custom Lego machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Builder" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GiveSets" name="Give Lego sets to children" messageRef="Message_LegoSets"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSorted" name="Receive sorted containers" messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsAvailable" name="Parts remain in a container?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsMerge" name="Continue with parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent from sorted parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Test successful?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Redesign" name="Redesign subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreComponents" name="More subcomponents remain?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assemble" name="Assemble subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Builder" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1" sourceRef="Start_Builder" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4" sourceRef="Task_GiveSets" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSorted" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B6" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_PartsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">partsRemainInContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B7" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noPartsRemainInContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B8" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_PartsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B9" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsMerge" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B10" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B11" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B12" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Gateway_MoreComponents">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B13" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_Redesign">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testUnsuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B14" sourceRef="Task_Redesign" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B15" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreComponents" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">moreSubcomponentsRemain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B16" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreComponents" targetRef="Task_Assemble">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noMoreSubcomponentsRemain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B17" sourceRef="Task_Assemble" targetRef="End_Builder"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Children" name="Sort Lego parts" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReceiveSets" name="Lego sets received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveSets" messageRef="Message_LegoSets"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReturnSorted" name="Return sorted containers" messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Task_ReturnSorted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_ReturnSorted" targetRef="End_Children"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LegoBrickSets" name="Lego brick sets"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SortedContainers" name="Sorted containers"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LegoMachine">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Builder" name="Machine builder" processRef="Process_Builder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Children" name="Group of children" processRef="Process_Children"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GiveSets" name="Give Lego brick sets to children"
                      sourceRef="Task_GiveSets" targetRef="Start_ReceiveSets"
                      messageRef="Message_LegoBrickSets"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnSortedContainers" name="Return sorted containers"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReturnSorted" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"
                      messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Builder" name="Build a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Builder" name="Begin machine design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GiveSets" name="Give Lego brick sets to children"
                   messageRef="Message_LegoBrickSets"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSorted" name="Receive sorted containers"
                      messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsForBuild" name="Are there parts left in a container?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderPartsForBuild" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergePartsForBuild" name="Continue with parts for building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent from sorted parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Was the subcomponent test successful?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign subcomponent"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsForRebuild" name="Are there parts left in a container for rebuilding?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderPartsForRebuild" name="Reorder individual parts for rebuilding"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergePartsForRebuild" name="Continue with parts for rebuilding"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RebuildSubcomponent" name="Rebuild subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" name="Are more subcomponents to build?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" name="Assemble subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_MachineAssembled" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1" sourceRef="Start_Builder" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4" sourceRef="Task_GiveSets" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSorted" targetRef="Gateway_PartsForBuild"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B6" name="Parts remain" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsForBuild" targetRef="Gateway_MergePartsForBuild">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">partsRemainInContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B7" name="No parts remain" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsForBuild" targetRef="Task_ReorderPartsForBuild">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noPartsRemainInContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B8" sourceRef="Task_ReorderPartsForBuild" targetRef="Gateway_MergePartsForBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B9" sourceRef="Gateway_MergePartsForBuild" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B10" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B11" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B12" name="Test successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B13" name="Test unsuccessful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testUnsuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B14" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_PartsForRebuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B15" name="Parts remain" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsForRebuild" targetRef="Gateway_MergePartsForRebuild">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">partsRemainInContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B16" name="No parts remain" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsForRebuild" targetRef="Task_ReorderPartsForRebuild">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noPartsRemainInContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B17" sourceRef="Task_ReorderPartsForRebuild" targetRef="Gateway_MergePartsForRebuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B18" sourceRef="Gateway_MergePartsForRebuild" targetRef="Task_RebuildSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B19" sourceRef="Task_RebuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B20" name="More subcomponents" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" targetRef="Gateway_PartsForBuild">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">moreSubcomponentsRemain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B21" name="All subcomponents tested successfully" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noMoreSubcomponentsRemain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B22" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" targetRef="End_MachineAssembled"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Children" name="Sort Lego parts into containers" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReceiveSets" name="Lego brick sets received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveSets" messageRef="Message_LegoBrickSets"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReturnSorted" name="Return sorted containers"
                   messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Children" name="Sorted containers returned"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Task_ReturnSorted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_ReturnSorted" targetRef="End_Children"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LegoSets" name="Lego brick sets"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SortedContainers" name="Sorted parts in containers"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LegoMachine">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Builder"
                      name="Machine builder"
                      processRef="Process_Builder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Children"
                      name="Group of children"
                      processRef="Process_Children"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GiveSets"
                      name="Give Lego sets to children"
                      sourceRef="Task_GiveSets"
                      targetRef="Start_ReceiveSets"
                      messageRef="Message_LegoSets"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnSortedContainers"
                      name="Return sorted containers"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReturnSorted"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"
                      messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Builder"
                name="Build a custom machine out of Lego bricks"
                isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Builder" name="Start building the machine"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop the basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GiveSets"
                   name="Give Lego sets to the children"
                   messageRef="Message_LegoSets"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSorted"
                      name="Receive sorted parts in containers"
                      messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_BuildAndTest"
                     name="Build and test a subcomponent">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Subcomponent" name="Start subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsAvailable"
                             name="Are there parts remaining in a container?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent"
                 name="Build the subcomponent from sorted parts"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test the subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult"
                             name="Was the subcomponent test successful?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"
                 name="Redesign the subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SubcomponentTestSuccessful"
                     name="Subcomponent test successful"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S1"
                         sourceRef="Start_Subcomponent"
                         targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S2"
                         sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"
                         targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">partsRemainInAContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S3"
                         sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"
                         targetRef="Task_ReorderParts">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noPartsRemainInAContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S4"
                         sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts"
                         targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S5"
                         sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"
                         targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S6"
                         sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"
                         targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S7"
                         sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult"
                         targetRef="End_SubcomponentTestSuccessful">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S8"
                         sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult"
                         targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testUnsuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S9"
                         sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"
                         targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents"
                           name="Are there more subcomponents to build?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponents"
               name="Assemble the subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_MachineAssembled" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1"
                       sourceRef="Start_Builder"
                       targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2"
                       sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign"
                       targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3"
                       sourceRef="Task_OrderSets"
                       targetRef="Task_GiveSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4"
                       sourceRef="Task_GiveSets"
                       targetRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B5"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"
                       targetRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B6"
                       sourceRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTest"
                       targetRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B7"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents"
                       targetRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTest">
